title: Start with a playable Guardian
summary: Use live account evidence first, then choose one achievable goal. Guardian Nexus never requires a perfect build before it gives you a useful next step.

steps.title: Follow Guardian Rank
steps.summary: Guardian Rank objectives introduce core systems and give you a concrete next milestone.

steps.title: Make a playable build
steps.summary: Build Advisor checks the equipment Bungie returned, suggests owned alternatives, and separates playable-now upgrades from ideal targets.

steps.title: Learn what you actually own
steps.summary: A physical roll can be equipped; a Collections unlock may only prove that an item was discovered. Unknown data is not treated as missing.

steps.title: Choose one session goal
steps.summary: Next Steps looks for overlapping progress so a short session can advance more than one pursuit.

steps.title: Protect your rewards
steps.summary: Check Postmaster capacity before long activities. Guardian Nexus may transfer or equip through supported APIs, but never dismantles gear or automates play.

terms.meaning: Bungie returned enough account data to confirm the state shown.
The required component was absent, private, stale, or unavailable; Guardian Nexus does not guess.
The account has discovered an item. It does not prove a usable physical copy or a particular roll is currently owned.
You entered or confirmed the information yourself; it is not presented as Bungie account truth.
